column1: # Child/teen age-estimation test set — 35 Mixkit clips, fetched by eval/age_kids/fetch.sh into data/age_kids/.
# Two age columns, both EYEBALLED ESTIMATES, neither ground truth — stock
#   est_age_band   the clip's main subject(s), for reading the table
#   eval_band      the LARGEST face specifically, which is what a largest-face
#                  measurement actually compares against. On the mixed_ and
#                  farfield_ clips that face is often the adult, so the two
#                  columns disagree on purpose. "-" means the largest face is
#                  not one person throughout: eval/age_kids/run_eval.py prints
#                  those clips but does not score them, because a median across
#                  two people has no right answer. That call belongs here, per
#                  clip, and not to a spread threshold in the script — scoring
#                  only the clips a given checkpoint happens to be steady on
#                  would compare two checkpoints on two different sets.
# eval_band is what eval/age_kids/run_eval.py scores. Use it for an age-GROUP
# confusion matrix and for hunting gross failures. Do not quote an MAE from it.
# max_faces / max_face_px are from 6 frames sampled across each clip with
# yolov8n-face @ conf 0.4. Compare max_face_px against CFG.min_face_px_for_age (24).
# All clips are 1280x720 except child_girl_legos (720x1280, portrait).
# license: Mixkit License — free commercial/non-commercial use, no attribution
# required, redistributing the raw clip is not. Source page for any clip:
